title: T46 desktop: More motion — idle variants, celebrate, Coworkers tag
head: t46-animated-tier
body:
## What
T46 desktop half (contract `docs/t46/contract.md` §1, §2, §6, §7, §8).

- **Pack reader** (`src/orb/avatarPack.ts`): optional `tier` (`standard`/`animated`), `frames` (4-12, = `grid.columns`), `fps` (6-12, = `grid.fps`) and extra rows `idle_variant_1..N` then optional `celebrate`, all refused with the existing `grid` code (paths `tier`, `frames`, `fps`, `grid.rows`). Extra rows only under `tier: animated`; an animated pack needs `idle_variant_1` and `celebrate` (§8.5). The sheet must be (128 x columns) by (128 x rows). Old packs read exactly as before.
- **Player** (`src/orb/avatarEngine.ts`, `OrbApp.tsx`, `hitMask.ts`): frames step at the pack's own count and rate (no more hardcoded `% 4`). The decoder sizes its canvas from the manifest and refuses, before allocating, any sheet over 12 x 32 cells (`MAX_SHEET_PIXELS`). This is the orb's second line: playbooks and agent-core now refuse a 9th idle variant (contract §8 item 7, at most 8), so the orb's size guard backs them up. The hit mask uses the sheet's real width. New `ExtraMotion` (injectable clock and random): while idle with at least one variant row, one timer at a uniform random 30-90 s; one variant plays once (never the same one twice in a row when there are two or more), then it re-arms; leaving idle cancels it. On the move into Done a `celebrate` row plays once, then the done row. Still (reduced motion, hidden, on battery) schedules nothing at all and shows one still frame.
- **Coworkers** (`avatarLibrary.ts`, `serviceClient.ts`, `useCoworkers.ts`, `CoworkerGrid.tsx`): rows carry `tier` (missing or unknown = `standard`). An animated tile gets a small "More motion" tag (the staged `.pill .pill--muted` primitive). When every pack in a category is animated, its heading reads "<Category name> · More motion" (for example "Pets · More motion"). Otherwise it reads just the category name. The name is never replaced (contract §8 item 8). An installed sheet's picture is drawn at the sheet's own size.
- **CSS**: the staged pill primitive ships (moved out of `primitives.staged.css`) in `coworkers.css`, which loads only with the page. Main CSS is byte-identical: 77.11 / 11.71 kB (budget 78 / 12, #178). Quick is unchanged at 35.53 kB. Coworkers chunk: 4.09 to 4.63 kB.
- CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased. Version stays 0.1.0, as this repo does per PR.

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check
22/22 killed. Each mutant was applied alone, then `npx vitest run`, then restored.

| mutant | killing test |
| --- | --- |
| variant delay min 20 s | avatarEngine: schedules an idle variant only inside [30 s, 90 s] |
| variant delay max 120 s | Orb: plays an idle variant within 90 s…; avatarEngine: only inside [30 s, 90 s] |
| fixed 30 s delay (not random) | Orb: plays an idle variant within 90 s…; avatarEngine: only inside [30 s, 90 s] |
| schedule under reduced motion (`still` ignored) | Orb: under reduced motion … no variant or celebrate timer at all; avatarEngine: never schedules anything under reduced motion |
| going still keeps the timers | avatarEngine: never schedules anything under reduced motion |
| celebrate replays while done | avatarEngine: plays celebrate once on the move into Done… |
| celebrate skipped on Done | Orb: …celebrates once on Done; avatarEngine: plays celebrate once… |
| celebrate plays twice through | Orb: …celebrates once on Done; avatarEngine: plays celebrate once… |
| "More motion" tag on a standard pack | Coworkers: shows the "More motion" tag only on animated tiles |
| heading when only some are animated (`every` to `some`) | Coworkers: a heading reads "<name> · More motion" only when every pack … is animated, and keeps its name (§8.8) |
| heading replaces the name with "More motion" | same test |
| heading drops " · More motion" | same test |
| a fixed word says "tier" | Coworkers: "<name> · More motion" heading test and no UI string says "tier", "fps" or "frames" |
| a tooltip says "frames" | Coworkers: no UI string says "tier", "fps" or "frames" |
| no re-arm after a variant | avatarEngine: plays one variant once, returns to idle, then re-arms… |
| same variant twice allowed | avatarEngine: never picks the same variant twice in a row… |
| leaving idle keeps the timer | avatarEngine: leaving idle cancels the timer… |
| frames hardcoded to 4 | avatarEngine: plays a pack at its own frame count and rate… |
| validator accepts 3/13 frames | avatarPack: refuses 3 / 13 frames… |
| validator ignores frames and columns mismatch | avatarPack: refuses frames or fps that do not match the grid |
| missing tier read as animated | serviceClientAvatars: parses rows and jobs as data… |
| extra rows allowed on a standard pack | avatarPack: allows extra rows only under the animated tier |

One first-round survivor (a dead `still` guard inside the timer callback) was removed as dead code: `update` already clears every timer on going still. Its replacement mutant ("going still keeps the timers") is killed.

## Tests
- `npm run typecheck`: clean.
- `npx vitest run`: 55 files, 1097 passed (was 1038).
- `npm run lint`: 0 errors, 1 old warning (`Onboarding.tsx:86`, not touched here).
- New: `tests/animatedPack.ts` (a made-up, all-transparent animated pack) and `tests/uiStrings.ts` (collects rendered text plus aria-label, aria-valuetext, title, alt and placeholder). `avatarPack.test.ts`: 4-12 frames and 6-12 fps accepted, outside refused, mismatches, tier values, the extra-row shapes, §8.5, sheet size, and old packs unchanged. `avatarEngine.test.ts`: frame math, the extra row played once and held, the hit mask on a taller sheet, the 30-90 s window, re-arm, the pick rule, cancel, reduced motion, fallbacks, celebrate once, the pack switch, the decoder's canvas size and cap. `Orb.test.tsx`: end to end with fake timers (a variant within 90 s, then celebrate once on Done; reduced motion schedules no timer). `Coworkers.test.tsx`: tag, heading ("Fantasy · More motion"; two all-animated categories each keep their own name), an older row with no tier, the word ban (DOM and every `WORDS` line), and the sheet size.
- `measure:idle` with an animated pack was not run here: it measures the installed, running Rig (currently `/Applications/OASIS.app`, which shows Beacon), not this branch.

## Mac check
Needs agent-core's T46 half (rows carry `tier`) and an animated pack (Fantasy or Pets) installed. Run it plugged in, with Reduce motion off.
1. Pick the animated coworker. Leave the orb idle. Within 90 s it plays one short extra move (stretch, look-around), then goes back to its usual idle. It repeats every 30-90 s and never plays the same move twice in a row.
2. Finish a task so the orb reaches Done. It celebrates once, then shows its normal done look. Beacon's Done looks exactly as it does today.
3. System Settings > Accessibility > Display > Reduce motion on: the orb holds one still picture. No extra move and no celebrate, however long you wait.
4. Coworkers page: animated tiles show a small grey "More motion" pill. A category where every pack is animated is headed with its own name plus " · More motion" (for example "Pets · More motion"; with round one, "Fantasy · More motion" too). A mixed category shows just its name. The words "tier", "fps" and "frames" appear nowhere.
5. `npm run measure:idle` with the animated pack in use: CPU stays under 1% of the machine.
